title: AAPS Stops Delivering Bolus and Basal at Random Times — Requires App Restart
symptom: At seemingly random times, AAPS stops delivering both bolus and basal insulin. The small progress line at the bottom of the screen flickers rapidly, indicating a background task is repeating quickly. This can lead to very high glucose levels overnight. The issue is temporarily resolved by restarting the app or toggling Bluetooth.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user suspects it is not a phone problem because toggling Bluetooth temporarily fixes it, but the maintainer states that the connection is not established by Android and there is nothing to do on the AAPS side.
fix: No permanent fix is provided. Temporary workarounds include selecting 'Exit' from the AAPS menu to restart the app, or toggling Bluetooth for a few seconds.
evidence_quote: The connection is not established by Android. There is nothing I can do on AAPS side
